findings.current: And the Doppelganger, whose summoning had set Morgoth’s arrival in motion, had long ago infiltrated human society and operated in secret.
findings.defect: The draft says the Doppelganger was summoned. The source says it helped set Morgoth’s summoning in motion.
findings.rationale: 모르고스 is the object of 소환; 도플갱어 is described as its 단초.
findings.replacement: And the Doppelganger, who had helped set Morgoth’s summoning in motion, had long ago infiltrated human society and operated in secret.
findings.source: 모르고스 소환의 단초가 되었던 도플갱어는 오래전부터 인간 사회에 녹아들어 암약하기까지 했다.

findings.current: Through the constant crackle of static, the view of a vast conference room was filled by a landscape thousands of kilometers away.
findings.defect: The draft makes the conference room the view on display. The source says a distant landscape fills the conference room; it also specifies tens of thousands of kilometers.
findings.rationale: 수만 킬로미터 밖의 풍경 is what fills 넓은 회의실 내부.
findings.replacement: Through the constant crackle of static, a landscape tens of thousands of kilometers away filled the vast conference room.
findings.source: 끊임없이 치직거리는 노이즈 속, 넓은 회의실 내부를 메운 것은 수만 킬로미터 밖의 풍경이었다.

summary: Two scene facts are reversed: who was summoned, and what appeared in the conference room.
